Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock down scope for the enterprise compliance epic. Customers pushing: audit log exports, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 gaps, and configurable retention. Who thinks what should be in MVP?
Samir (Eng): My vote: audit logs (search + export) first, then BYOK. Export is low-risk frontend + storage work. BYOK is infra-heavy.
Marco (Security Eng): Agree order. FYI BYOK touches key lifecycle, rotation, and HSM/KMS integrations. Need design doc for key escrow vs. customer-provided keys.
Beth (Legal): From contracts POV, customers expect: immutable exportability, export audit trail, and clear retention defaults with opt-in longer retention. SOC2 checklist will ask for retention policy proofs.
Elaine (PM): Ok. Proposed MVP scope: 1) Audit log streaming -> S3 export (customer-owned buckets opt-in later), 2) Retention UI with presets + API, 3) Logging schema v1 that includes request_id, tenant_id, model, and redaction flag. BYOK scoped to alpha (private deployment only). Does that sound reasonable?
Samir (Eng): Sounds pragmatic. Couple of follow-ups: a) are we OK with server-side exported blobs being encrypted with our keys for hosted customers? b) need timeframe for schema contract.
Marco (Security Eng): a) For hosted customers, default encrypted-at-rest with our KMS is fine, but we must document key access model. For BYOK alpha, we allow bringing a wrapped key material to Dedicated/Private only. No BYOK for hosted MVP. b) Schema must be stable for 6 months.
Beth (Legal): Confirming we need an attestation artifact for SOC2 that shows retention policy enforcement and deletion logs. Also need to check exportability for regulated customers (some require cross-border controls).
Samir (Eng): Implementation note: we can fake exports initially by zipping logs per-tenant and dropping to a staging bucket with lifecycle rules. CLI snippet I used previously:
```
redwood logs export --tenant acme --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-02-28 --format ndjson --out acme-feb.ndjson
```
That gives customers immediate export while we build S3 connector.
Elaine (PM): Good incremental approach. Add canaries for retention enforcement and sampling in Console. Also need rollout criteria: - export working end-to-end for 2 pilots, - retention UI QA pass, - SOC2 attestation draft available.
Marco (Security Eng): Also add automated verification: nightly job that checks deletion events and alerts on mismatches. Add metric: percentage of deletion requests successfully processed within SLA.
Beth (Legal): For BYOK alpha, include contract appendix that limits risk and describes incident handling for key compromise.
compliance-bot: Checklist created -> items: audit-log-schema, export-pipeline, retention-ui, retention-metrics, soc2-evidence, byok-alpha-policy.
Elaine (PM): Action items: Samir create export-pipeline RFC by Fri (1778968400), Marco draft BYOK design for private by Mon, Beth draft SOC2 evidence list and contract language. I'll schedule a pilot sync next Wednesday.
Samir (Eng): +1 starting RFC now. Will call out expected infra cost and rollout plan.
Marco (Security Eng): Will include threat model and KMS integration matrix.
Beth (Legal): I'll collate required artifacts and sample contract snippet.
Elaine (PM): Thanks all. If any blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Samir (Eng): One more note — we should capture retention exceptions (legal holds). Need API for hold_start/hold_end.
Beth (Legal): Yes. Legal holds are non-negotiable for some customers. Add to scope as "retain override" with audit trail.
Elaine (PM): Adding "retain override (legal hold)" to MVP must-have list.
compliance-bot: Updated checklist -> added legal-hold feature.
